Author: OmegaJackie
Name: CineSync
Punchline: Self-hosted synced in-world media screens for movie nights.
Description: Host a small server; paired friends connect and automatically see the in-world screens (TVs) you create, all playing the same media. Move/resize/rotate gizmo, LibVLC video, auto-reconnect. Pairs with a self-hosted Owncast stream.
Changelog: Volume controls: a Volume slider and Mute under Audio, plus /cinesync volume 0-100 (+N/-N nudges it) and /cinesync mute for macros. Volume is your own, never synced to the room, and one level covers every screen. It starts at 100%, and it overrides the Windows volume mixer for CineSync audio.
